data.exact_reserve_text: The run-off improvement for Syndicate 2243 relating to prior year's business was GBP 3.3m. This was mainly attributable to the Construction class which improved by GBP 2.6m following better than expected claims experience in 2014.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2243 reported a run-off improvement of GBP 3.3 million for prior year business in 2014, indicating a release of reserves. This favorable development was primarily driven by better than expected claims experience. The Construction class was mainly responsible for GBP 2.6 million of this improvement, with the Casualty class also contributing to the overall positive trend.
raw_causal_phrases: strong performances in both the Construction and Casualty classes, where ultimate loss ratios have reduced following favourable claims experience over the year

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The syndicate entered into a reinsurance to close (RITC) agreement effective 31 December 2014, which means the closing claims outstanding for 2014 reflects the RITC premium. This would distort any claims development triangle, making it unreliable for prior year development calculation. No claims development triangle was found in the report. The 'Construction class' mentioned in the report for LOB movements has been mapped to 'Property' as the closest standard Lloyd's LOB.
